decisions.checklist: 747 explicit cards in eight full collector families. Independently retrieve every base/parallel/insert namespace. Include both unnumbered checklist cards, each verified from front/back scans. Exclude dealer/media J.D. Drew SAMPLE promo; no pack-issued autograph or memorabilia family verified. Beckett summary displays 176 entries while its description specifies 175; follow verified numbered #1–175 and exclude the documented SAMPLE promo instead of inventing #176.
decisions.rookies: Only 12 verified true base RCs, agreeing exactly across TCDB base, separately retrieved rookie index and BCP. Rookie subset #126-175 has 50 cards and is not itself proof of true RC. Do not infer RC suffixes on parallels or inserts. Scott Hunter RC* is a recognized rookie of a player who did not reach MLB.
decisions.names: Preserve clean TCDB player names and historical on-card teams. BCP nickname differences are explicitly normalized; Mark Johnson #153 is White Sox catcher Mark L. Johnson, not the other Mark Johnson. J.D. Drew, Roy Halladay, Carlos Beltran and Mike Lowell Rookie-subset cards do not get true RC tags. Canonical base/BCP Robert Fick #132 and parallel-source Rob Fick refer to the same Detroit player; normalize the three parallel names to Robert Fick.
decisions.numbering: Keep B/G/TG base-parallel suffixes and space-separated I/SS/P insert collector numbers. Do not renumber Pulsars as SS. Give unnumbered checklists stable NNO-A/NNO-B identifiers and move printed ranges to variant.
decisions.teams: Every player card has a verified historical franchise. Only two generic checklists have intentionally blank teams; no invented MLB/League/Multiple team. Team data complete under the checklist exception.
decisions.error: Base #128 Gabe Kapler prints birth date 8/31/75; actual 7/31/1975 verified via official profile and source trivia. Preserve UER in variant, not player. Do not extrapolate error annotation to unreviewed parallel backs.
decisions.pack: Five cards per pack, 24 packs per box, verified by original pack and box scans and BCP. Single series. Existing engine uses independent ProductSet hit rolls replacing base slots; historical card positions, within-family Rookie scarcity and pack correlations are not reproduced. Keep complete collector families rather than split ranges. Pack QA pending before release.
decisions.blueOdds: Physical Blue veterans #1B–125B: 1:3 packs; Rookie subset #126B–175B: 1:6. Aggregate expected frequency 1/3+1/6=1/2 Blue card per pack. VCS denominator 2 represents that expectation with one uniform complete Blue pool, not exact physical range weighting or co-occurrence. No odds in card variants.
decisions.unknownOdds: Gold /99, 24KT Gold /24 and the two checklist cards lack verified insertion denominators. Leave null, stage all cards for pricing/images, and require odds review. Do not fabricate rates from serial print runs.
decisions.release: Unreleased draft for Admin pricing and image harvesting; no production database changes or deployment. Pack/unknown odds, images and pricing pending release QA.

This is an explicit VCS approximation, not exact range weighting or a claim about co-occurrence.
